statement: For nonzero model margin, an l_q attack that preserves the linear target exists iff epsilon times the dual-norm distance of the orthogonal predictor component to span(w_star) is at least the absolute model margin.
assumptions: the unperturbed model margin is nonzero
the perturbation belongs to the closed l_q ball
target invariance is equivalent to <w_star, delta> = 0
baseline_scope: q=2; 400 deterministic strict non-boundary numerical cases
